Trinity Music Series

At Trinity, music is more than performance: it is connection, inspiration, and transformation. Step into the cathedral and experience our concerts, organ recitals, Choral Evensong, and special events.

Explore the 2026-27 Season!

Luminous. Breathtaking. Uplifting.

Concert Series

  • Fri, Sep 25
    Chapel Voices: An Evening of Early Music / 
    Learn more
    Sep 25, 2026, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
    Experience an intimate evening of Renaissance and Baroque chamber music presented in the luminous Trinity Chapel.
  • Sat, Oct 24
    PipeScreams Halloween Spectacular! / 
    Learn more
    Oct 24, 2026, 5:00 PM – 6:30 PM
    Magic in the Air | This Halloween, Enchanting and Enravishing Musical Tricks & Treats for All Ages
  • Fri, Nov 13
    Celebrity Organ Concert: Nathan Laube / 
    Learn more
    Nov 13, 2026, 7:00 PM – 10:00 PM
    Internationally-acclaimed organist Nathan Laube plays a thrilling recital of major works to celebrate the Rosales organ’s 40th birthday!
  • Fri, Dec 18
    Christmas Concert: Vivaldi Gloria & Haydn Nikolaimesse / 
    Learn more
    Dec 18, 2026, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM PST
    Trinity Music and Portland Baroque Orchestra present two beloved major works for the season: Vivaldi Gloria & Haydn Nikolaimesse!
  • Sat, Jan 30
    Organ Recital: Katie Webb & James Walton / 
    Learn more
    Jan 30, 2027, 2:00 PM – 3:30 PM
    Trinity’s musicians team up to present a vibrant program of French music as part of the organ’s 40th birthday celebrations.
  • Mon, Feb 01
    St. Olaf Choir in Concert / 
    Learn more
    Feb 01, 2027, 7:00 PM
    The St. Olaf Choir, conducted by Anton Armstrong, returns to the Pacific Northwest with a program sure to inspire, strengthen, and uplift its audience!
  • Fri, Feb 19
    Cabaret / 
    Learn more
    Feb 19, 2027, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
    A fun, raucous, delicious, and edifying evening of musical theater favorites, sung by members of the Cathedral Schola, with a silent auction benefitting Trinity Music!
  • Sun, Mar 21
    iCantori in Concert / 
    Learn more
    Mar 21, 2027, 6:00 PM – 7:30 PM
    Conducted by Kraig Scott, Walla Walla University’s top choir offers a varied program of exciting choral repertoire in Trinity’s beautiful nave.
  • Tue, Apr 20
    New York Polyphony in Concert / 
    Learn more
    Apr 20, 2027, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
    New York Polyphony, one of America’s premiere vocal ensembles, makes its first appearance at Trinity at this free concert!
  • Fri, Apr 23
    Crozier Concert: Mark Laubach / 
    Learn more
    Apr 23, 2027, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
    Mark Laubach puts the Rosales organ through its paces in this thrilling annual recital honoring Trinity’s former Artist-in-Residence, Dr. Catharine Crozier.
  • Fri, May 21
    Organ Concert: Carson Cooman / 
    Learn more
    May 21, 2027, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
    Carson Cooman, one of the most prolific living composers of organ music, offers a celebratory program in honor of the 40th anniversary of the Rosales organ.
Single tickets on sale now!

Evensong & Special Services

Through music & spoken word, sound & silence, we invite you to find a “thin space” in which to encounter the mystery & beauty of the spirit.
  • Sun, Oct 04
    Blessing of the Animals at Evensong / 
    Learn more
    Oct 04, 2026, 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM
    Bring your furry and feathered friends into the cathedral for a very special service of Choral Evensong for the Feast of St. Francis, followed by the Blessing of the Animals!
  • Multiple Dates
    Sun, Nov 01
    All Souls Evensong / 
    Learn more
    Nov 01, 2026, 5:00 PM – 6:00 PM
    The Cathedral Choir & Choir School offer contemplative music at this monthly service of Choral Evensong.
  • Sun, Dec 06
    Advent Lessons & Carols / 
    Learn more
    Dec 06, 2026, 5:00 PM – 6:30 PM
    Join the Cathedral Choir and Choristers for this beloved annual service of readings and music for the Advent season.
  • Fri, Mar 26
    Choral Meditation for Good Friday / 
    Learn more
    Mar 26, 2027, 7:00 PM – 8:30 PM
    A service of poetry, readings, hymns, and choral music for Good Friday, sung by the Cathedral Schola.
